rem Squares under a hyperbola
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=247
rem Find the largest n for which the nth
rem square under y = 1 / x, x >= 1, in
rem order of size has Right squares to
rem its left and Up squares below it

use bits
use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg Right integer = 3
arg Up integer = 3
arg Cap integer = 1000000

rem A square with its lower left corner
rem at (a, b) has the side s with
rem (a + s) (b + s) = 1. It opens a
rem region to its right at (a + s, b)
rem and one above at (a, b + s), so the
rem squares of index (Right, Up) come
rem from the paths of Right steps right
rem and Up steps up. The smallest of
rem them is last, and n counts every
rem square as large, found by a
rem depth-first walk.
Steps = Right + Up
Paths = 0 till (1 shl Steps) array
Ones' = Paths popcount
Fit' = Ones equal Right
Paths = Paths filter Fit array
A = Paths - Paths + 1.0
B = A - A
for T in 0 till Steps
  Tot = A + B
  Disc = Tot * Tot - 4 * (A * B - 1)
  Rt' = Disc sqrt
  S = (Rt - Tot) / 2
  Go = (Paths bit T) choose 1.0 0.0
  A += S * Go
  B += S * (1.0 - Go)
end
Tot = A + B
Rt = (Tot * Tot - 4 * (A * B - 1)) sqrt
Sides' = (Rt - Tot) / 2
Eps = 1 - 0.000000000001
Small = (Sides min) * Eps
Xs = array shape Cap fill 0.0
Ys = array shape Cap fill 0.0
Xs 0 = 1.0
Top = 1
Answer = 0
for Step in 1 to (Cap * 4)
  Top -= 1
  X = Xs Top
  Y = Ys Top
  Sm = X + Y
  Dd = (Sm * Sm - 4 * (X * Y - 1)) sqrt
  S = (Dd - Sm) / 2
  if S at least Small
    Answer += 1
    Xs Top = X + S
    Ys Top = Y
    Xs (Top + 1) = X
    Ys (Top + 1) = Y + S
    Top += 2
  end
  if Top equal 0
    break
  end
end
Answer print

rem Squares under a hyperbola
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=247
rem Find the largest n for which the nth
rem square under y = 1 / x, x >= 1, in
rem order of size has Right squares to
rem its left and Up squares below it

use bits
use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg Right integer = 3
arg Up integer = 3
arg Cap integer = 1000000

rem A square with its lower left corner
rem at (a, b) has the side s with
rem (a + s) (b + s) = 1. It opens a
rem region to its right at (a + s, b)
rem and one above at (a, b + s), so the
rem squares of index (Right, Up) come
rem from the paths of Right steps right
rem and Up steps up. The smallest of
rem them is last, and n counts every
rem square as large, found by a
rem depth-first walk.
Steps = Right + Up
Paths = 0 till (1 shl Steps) array
Ones' = Paths popcount
Fit' = Ones equal Right
Paths = Paths filter Fit array
A = Paths - Paths + 1.0
B = A - A
for T in 0 till Steps
  Tot = A + B
  Disc = Tot * Tot - 4 * (A * B - 1)
  Rt' = Disc sqrt
  S = (Rt - Tot) / 2
  Go = (Paths bit T) choose 1.0 0.0
  A += S * Go
  B += S * (1.0 - Go)
end
Tot = A + B
Rt = (Tot * Tot - 4 * (A * B - 1)) sqrt
Sides' = (Rt - Tot) / 2
Eps = 1 - 0.000000000001
Small = (Sides min) * Eps
rem Pending siblings follow upward steps.
rem Each adds at least Small to Y < 1.
StackCap = Cap min ((1.0 / Small) ceil + 2)
Xs = array shape StackCap fill 0.0
Ys = array shape StackCap fill 0.0
Xs 0 = 1.0
Top = 1
Answer = 0
for Step in 1 to (Cap * 4)
  Top -= 1
  X = Xs Top
  Y = Ys Top
  Sm = X + Y
  Dd = (Sm * Sm - 4 * (X * Y - 1)) sqrt
  S = (Dd - Sm) / 2
  if S at least Small
    Answer += 1
    Nx = X + S
    Ny = Y + S
    rem A child fits iff its Small square
    rem stays under the hyperbola.
    if (Nx + Small) * (Y + Small) at most 1
      Xs Top = Nx
      Ys Top = Y
      Top += 1
    end
    if (X + Small) * (Ny + Small) at most 1
      Xs Top = X
      Ys Top = Ny
      Top += 1
    end
  end
  if Top equal 0
    break
  end
end
Answer print
